passages.text: In the eighteenth year of Jeroboam’s reign, Abijah became king of Judah, and he reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother’s name was Micaiah daughter of Uriel; she was from Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
passages.sermon:
Abijah became king of Judah.
This happened in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam’s reign.
Abijah ruled in Jerusalem.
He reigned for three years.
Abijah’s mother was Micaiah.
Micaiah was the daughter of Uriel.
Uriel was from Gibeah.
There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
passages.original: בִּשְׁנַ֛ת שְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יָרָבְעָ֑ם וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ אֲבִיָּ֖ה עַל־ יְהוּדָֽה׃ שָׁל֣וֹשׁ שָׁנִ֗ים מָלַךְ֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ מִיכָיָ֥הוּ בַת־ אוּרִיאֵ֖ל מִן־ גִּבְעָ֑ה וּמִלְחָמָ֥ה הָיְתָ֛ה בֵּ֥ין אֲבִיָּ֖ה וּבֵ֥ין יָרָבְעָֽם׃

passages.text: Abijah went into battle with an army of 400,000 chosen men, while Jeroboam drew up in formation against him with 800,000 chosen and mighty men of valor.
passages.sermon:
Abijah was king of Judah.
Abijah prepared for battle.
He gathered an army.
His army had 400,000 chosen men.
These men were strong and brave soldiers.
Jeroboam was king of Israel.
Jeroboam also prepared for battle.
He gathered his army.
His army had 800,000 chosen men.
These men were also strong and brave soldiers.
Jeroboam set his army in formation against Abijah.
passages.original: וַיֶּאְסֹ֨ר אֲבִיָּ֜ה אֶת־ הַמִּלְחָמָ֗ה בְּחַ֙יִל֙ גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י מִלְחָמָ֔ה אַרְבַּע־ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף אִ֣ישׁ בָּח֑וּרס וְיָרָבְעָ֗ם עָרַ֤ךְ עִמּוֹ֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה בִּשְׁמוֹנֶ֨ה מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֛לֶף אִ֥ישׁ בָּח֖וּר גִּבּ֥וֹר חָֽיִל׃ס

passages.text: Then Abijah stood on Mount Zemaraim in the hill country of Ephraim and said, “Hear me, O Jeroboam and all Israel!
passages.sermon:
Abijah was the king of Judah.
He stood on Mount Zemaraim.
Mount Zemaraim is in the hill country of Ephraim.
Abijah spoke to the people.
He said, “Hear me, Jeroboam and all Israel!”
passages.original: וַיָּ֣קָם אֲבִיָּ֗ה מֵעַל֙ לְהַ֣ר צְמָרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיֹּ֕אמֶר שְׁמָע֖וּנִי יָרָבְעָ֥ם וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Do you not know that the LORD, the God of Israel, has given the kingship of Israel to David and his descendants forever by a covenant of salt ?
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD gave the kingship of Israel to David.
The LORD gave this kingship to David and his descendants.
The LORD gave it to them forever.
The LORD made this promise by a covenant of salt.
passages.original: הֲלֹ֤א לָכֶם֙ לָדַ֔עַת כִּ֞י יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נָתַ֨ן מַמְלָכָ֧ה לְדָוִ֛יד עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְעוֹלָ֑ם ל֥וֹ וּלְבָנָ֖יו בְּרִ֥ית מֶֽלַח׃ס

passages.text: Yet Jeroboam son of Nebat, a servant of Solomon son of David, rose up and rebelled against his master.
passages.sermon:
Jeroboam was the son of Nebat.
Jeroboam served Solomon.
Solomon was the son of David.
Jeroboam rebelled against his master.
passages.original: וַיָּ֙קָם֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֔ט עֶ֖בֶד שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בֶן־ דָּוִ֑יד וַיִּמְרֹ֖ד עַל־ אֲדֹנָֽיו׃

passages.text: Then worthless and wicked men gathered around him to resist Rehoboam son of Solomon when he was young, inexperienced, and unable to resist them.
passages.sermon:
Worthless and wicked men gathered around Jeroboam.
They opposed Rehoboam.
Rehoboam was the son of Solomon.
Rehoboam was young.
Rehoboam was inexperienced.
Rehoboam could not stand firm against them.
passages.original: וַיִּקָּבְצ֣וּ עָלָ֗יו אֲנָשִׁ֤ים רֵקִים֙ בְּנֵ֣י בְלִיַּ֔עַל וַיִּֽתְאַמְּצ֖וּ עַל־ רְחַבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וּרְחַבְעָ֗ם הָ֤יָה נַ֙עַר֙ וְרַךְ־ לֵבָ֔ב וְלֹ֥א הִתְחַזַּ֖ק לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: And now you think you can resist the kingdom of the LORD, which is in the hands of David’s descendants. You are indeed a vast army, and you have with you the golden calves that Jeroboam made for you as gods.
passages.sermon:
You are facing the kingdom of the LORD.
The LORD has given this kingdom to the descendants of David.
You believe you can stand against this kingdom.
You have a large number of people with you.
You also have the golden calves with you.
Jeroboam made these golden calves for you.
You treat these golden calves as your gods.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה׀ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹֽמְרִ֗ים לְהִתְחַזֵּק֙ לִפְנֵי֙ מַמְלֶ֣כֶת יְהוָ֔ה בְּיַ֖ד בְּנֵ֣י דָוִ֑יד וְאַתֶּם֙ הָמ֣וֹן רָ֔ב וְעִמָּכֶם֙ עֶגְלֵ֣י זָהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם יָרָבְעָ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: But did you not drive out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites? And did you not make priests for yourselves as do the peoples of other lands? Now whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams can become a priest of things that are not gods.
passages.sermon:
You drove out the priests of the LORD.
These priests were the sons of Aaron.
You also drove out the Levites.
You made priests for yourselves.
You acted like the peoples of other lands.
Anyone who comes with a young bull and seven rams can become a priest for you.
These priests serve things that are not gods.
passages.original: הֲלֹ֤א הִדַּחְתֶּם֙ אֶת־ כֹּהֲנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְהַלְוִיִּ֑ם וַתַּעֲשׂ֨וּ לָכֶ֤ם כֹּהֲנִים֙ כְּעַמֵּ֣י הָאֲרָצ֔וֹת כָּל־ הַבָּ֗א לְמַלֵּ֨א יָד֜וֹ בְּפַ֤ר בֶּן־ בָּקָר֙ וְאֵילִ֣ם שִׁבְעָ֔ה וְהָיָ֥ה כֹהֵ֖ן לְלֹ֥א אֱלֹהִֽים׃ס

passages.text: But as for us, the LORD is our God. We have not forsaken Him; the priests who minister to the LORD are sons of Aaron, and the Levites attend to their duties.
passages.sermon:
We serve the LORD.
The LORD is our God.
We have not abandoned Him.
The priests serve the LORD.
These priests are sons of Aaron.
The Levites also serve.
The Levites perform their duties.
passages.original: וַאֲנַ֛חְנוּ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ וְלֹ֣א עֲזַבְנֻ֑הוּ וְכֹ֨הֲנִ֜ים מְשָׁרְתִ֤ים לַֽיהוָה֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְהַלְוִיִּ֖ם בַּמְלָֽאכֶת׃

passages.text: Every morning and every evening they present burnt offerings and fragrant incense to the LORD. They set out the rows of showbread on the ceremonially clean table, and every evening they light the lamps of the gold lampstand. We are carrying out the requirements of the LORD our God, while you have forsaken Him.
passages.sermon:
The priests and Levites serve the LORD.
Every morning they offer burnt offerings to the LORD.
Every evening they offer burnt offerings to the LORD.
They burn fragrant incense to the LORD.
They place the rows of showbread on the clean table.
They light the lamps of the gold lampstand every evening.
We obey the commands of the LORD our God.
You have abandoned the LORD.
passages.original: וּמַקְטִרִ֣ים לַיהוָ֡ה עֹל֣וֹת בַּבֹּֽקֶר־ בַּבֹּ֣קֶר וּבָעֶֽרֶב־ בָּעֶ֣רֶב וּקְטֹֽרֶת־ סַמִּים֩ וּמַעֲרֶ֨כֶת לֶ֜חֶם עַל־ הַשֻּׁלְחָ֣ן הַטָּה֗וֹר וּמְנוֹרַ֨ת הַזָּהָ֤ב וְנֵרֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ לְבָעֵר֙ בָּעֶ֣רֶב בָּעֶ֔רֶב כִּֽי־ שֹׁמְרִ֣ים אֲנַ֔חְנוּ אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְאַתֶּ֖ם עֲזַבְתֶּ֥ם אֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Now behold, God Himself is with us as our head, and His priests with their trumpets sound the battle call against you. O children of Israel, do not fight against the LORD, the God of your fathers, for you will not succeed.”
passages.sermon:
God is with us.
God leads us.
His priests are with us.
The priests have trumpets.
The priests sound the battle call against you.
Children of Israel, do not fight against the LORD.
The LORD is the God of your fathers.
You will not succeed if you fight against Him.
passages.original: וְהִנֵּה֩ עִמָּ֨נוּ בָרֹ֜אשׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֧ים׀ וְכֹהֲנָ֛יו וַחֲצֹצְר֥וֹת הַתְּרוּעָ֖ה לְהָרִ֣יעַ עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אַל־ תִּלָּֽחֲמ֛וּ עִם־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם כִּי־ לֹ֥א תַצְלִֽיחוּ׃

passages.text: Now Jeroboam had sent troops around to ambush from the rear, so that while he was in front of Judah, the ambush was behind them.
passages.sermon:
Jeroboam was the king of Israel.
He sent his troops to set an ambush.
The ambush came from behind Judah.
Jeroboam himself stood in front of Judah.
The ambush was behind Judah.
Judah was surrounded by Jeroboam in front and the ambush behind.
passages.original: וְיָֽרָבְעָ֗ם הֵסֵב֙ אֶת־ הַמַּאְרָ֔ב לָב֖וֹא מֵֽאַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וְהַמַּאְרָ֖ב מֵאַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: When Judah turned and discovered that the battle was both before and behind them, they cried out to the LORD. Then the priests blew the trumpets, and the men of Judah raised the battle cry. And when they raised the cry, God routed Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
passages.sermon:
Judah was a tribe of Israel.
Judah turned around.
They saw the battle was in front of them and behind them.
They were surrounded.
The men of Judah cried out to the LORD.
The priests blew the trumpets.
The men of Judah shouted a battle cry.
When the men of Judah shouted, God acted.
God defeated Jeroboam and all Israel.
God did this in front of Abijah and Judah.
passages.original: וַיִּפְנ֣וּ יְהוּדָ֗ה וְהִנֵּ֨ה לָהֶ֤ם הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ פָּנִ֣ים וְאָח֔וֹר וַֽיִּצְעֲק֖וּ לַיהוָ֑ה וְהַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים מַחֲצֹצְרִים בַּחֲצֹצְרֽוֹת׃ וַיָּרִ֖יעוּ אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיְהִ֗י בְּהָרִ֙יעַ֙ אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְהָאֱלֹהִ֗ים נָגַ֤ף אֶת־ יָֽרָבְעָם֙ וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִפְנֵ֥י אֲבִיָּ֖ה וִיהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: So the Israelites fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hands.
passages.sermon: The Israelites ran away from Judah.\r\nGod gave the Israelites into the hands of Judah.
passages.original: וַיָּנ֥וּסוּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִפְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּיָדָֽם׃

passages.text: Then Abijah and his people struck them with a mighty blow, and 500,000 chosen men of Israel fell slain.
passages.sermon:
Abijah was the king of Judah.
Abijah led his people in battle.
Abijah and his people attacked the army of Israel.
They struck the army of Israel with a mighty blow.
Five hundred thousand chosen men from Israel fell dead.
passages.original: וַיַּכּ֥וּ בָהֶ֛ם אֲבִיָּ֥ה וְעַמּ֖וֹ מַכָּ֣ה רַבָּ֑ה וַיִּפְּל֤וּ חֲלָלִים֙ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֔ל חֲמֵשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף אִ֥ישׁ בָּחֽוּר׃

passages.text: Thus the Israelites were subdued at that time, and the men of Judah prevailed because they relied on the LORD, the God of their fathers.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites lost their strength at that time.
The men of Judah became strong.
The men of Judah trusted in the LORD.
The LORD is the God of their fathers.
passages.original: וַיִּכָּנְע֥וּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑יא וַיֶּֽאֶמְצוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה כִּ֣י נִשְׁעֲנ֔וּ עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Abijah pursued Jeroboam and captured some cities from him: Bethel, Jeshanah, and Ephron, along with their villages.
passages.sermon:
Abijah was the king of Judah.
Jeroboam was the king of Israel.
Abijah pursued Jeroboam.
Abijah captured cities from Jeroboam.
Abijah took Bethel and its villages.
Abijah took Jeshanah and its villages.
Abijah took Ephron and its villages.
passages.original: וַיִּרְדֹּ֣ף אֲבִיָּה֮ אַחֲרֵ֣י יָרָבְעָם֒ וַיִּלְכֹּ֤ד מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ עָרִ֔ים אֶת־ בֵּֽית־ אֵל֙ וְאֶת־ בְּנוֹתֶ֔יהָ וְאֶת־ יְשָׁנָ֖ה וְאֶת־ בְּנוֹתֶ֑יהָ וְאֶת־ עֶפְרוֹן וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: Jeroboam did not again recover his power during the days of Abijah, and the LORD struck him down and he died.
passages.sermon:
Jeroboam was the king of Israel.
Abijah was the king of Judah.
Jeroboam did not regain his strength during Abijah’s reign.
The LORD struck Jeroboam.
Jeroboam died.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ עָצַ֧ר כֹּֽחַ־ יָרָבְעָ֛ם ע֖וֹד בִּימֵ֣י אֲבִיָּ֑הוּ וַיִּגְּפֵ֥הוּ יְהוָ֖ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃פ

passages.text: But Abijah grew strong, married fourteen wives, and became the father of twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.
passages.sermon:
Abijah was king of Judah.
Abijah became strong.
Abijah married fourteen wives.
Abijah had twenty-two sons.
Abijah had sixteen daughters.
passages.original: וַיִּתְחַזֵּ֣ק אֲבִיָּ֔הוּ וַיִּ֨שָּׂא־ ל֔וֹ נָשִׁ֖ים אַרְבַּ֣ע עֶשְׂרֵ֑ה וַיּ֗וֹלֶד עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּשְׁנַ֙יִם֙ בָּנִ֔ים וְשֵׁ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה בָּנֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: Now the rest of the acts of Abijah, along with his ways and his words, are written in the Treatise of the Prophet Iddo.
passages.sermon:
Abijah was a king of Judah.
Iddo was a prophet.
The Treatise of the Prophet Iddo is a written record.
The rest of Abijah’s acts are written in this treatise.
Abijah’s ways are written in this treatise.
Abijah’s words are written in this treatise.
passages.original: וְיֶ֙תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י אֲבִיָּ֔ה וּדְרָכָ֖יו וּדְבָרָ֑יו כְּתוּבִ֕ים בְּמִדְרַ֖שׁ הַנָּבִ֥יא עִדּֽוֹ׃
